title: Officer Leslie Coffelt U.S. Secret Service Police Act of 2026
latestAction: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by Voice Vote.
summary:
The following analysis is based on draft bill text that was made available by the House of Representatives and may differ from the bill text as introduced.

Officer Leslie Coffelt U.S. Secret Service Police Act

This bill renames the U.S. Secret Service Uniformed Division as the U.S. Secret Service Police and revises federal statutory references accordingly.

actions.text: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by Voice Vote.
